transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Severus. Please, have a seat. I've completed the preliminary scans on the Mark. The results are... unusual.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Unusual in what way, exactly? I fail to see how anything connected to the Mark could surprise you at this point.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: The magical signature is... shifting. It's not static as we've always documented. I can't yet determine if it's reacting to an external stimulus, or if the curse itself is... evolving. Your core magical stability appears intact, for now.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Evolution? I thought that was a word best left to the Muggle scientists. Nonetheless, I'm interested in the implications of your findings. What are the potential outcomes for my... condition?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: That is precisely what I cannot yet tell you. It could be a benign fluctuation, a reaction to some distant magical event, or... it could indicate a fundamental change in the curse's nature. I need to run deeper diagnostic charms. They will be invasive and may cause discomfort. The process will take several days.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Discomfort, you say. How delightfully reassuring. Very well, proceed with your... diagnostic procedure. I trust you'll ensure that the utmost discretion is maintained, given the nature of the Mark.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Of course. Your privacy is paramount. The diagnostic suite is warded and accessible only to myself. I must warn you, the charms will probe the magical symbiosis between the Mark and your own core. It may feel... intrusive.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I have experienced far worse in my time, Healer. Your procedure will doubtless pale in comparison to the... delights... of the Dark Arts. I am ready when you are.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Very well. We'll begin tomorrow morning. In the meantime, I advise you to avoid any strenuous spellcasting. Report any unusual sensations in the Mark immediately, no matter how minor.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I'll keep you appraised of any developments, I assure you. It's not as though I have much choice in the matter. Good night, Healer. I'll see you at the... appropriate hour.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Good night, Severus. Rest as well as you can. We'll get to the bottom of this.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Indeed. Your optimism is touching. I trust you'll inform me if you require... additional assistance. Until then, I'll await your insights with bated breath. Good night.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Good night, Severus. I'll see you in the morning.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Yes, I'm sure we'll have a... pleasant morning together. Until then.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: *Nods curtly, maintaining a professional demeanor as he leaves*

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: [Severus Snape waits until the Healer has left the room before allowing himself to show any sign of discomfort. He winces slightly, pressing a hand to the spot where the Dark Mark rests. "Unusual," he mutters under his breath. "Always interesting..."]

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: [The door opens slightly, the Healer having forgotten a diagnostic scroll. He pauses, seeing the gesture, but says nothing, merely retrieving the parchment.] My apologies. I'll leave you to your rest.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: As you wish. I'll not trouble you further. Good night, Healer.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Good night, Severus. Remember to report any changes.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: [Severus Snape inclines his head marginally, a shadow of a frown creasing his brow. "Of course," he responds with a touch of impatience. "I am not in the habit of neglecting my own well-being, despite what you may assume. Good night, Healer."]

Openness.behavioral_evidence: He expresses interest in the 'unusual' and 'evolving' nature of the Mark, showing intellectual curiosity despite his sarcasm.

Conscientiousness.behavioral_evidence: He insists on discretion, agrees to report any changes, and states he is not in the habit of neglecting his well-being.

Extraversion.behavioral_evidence: His communication is terse, sarcastic, and focused on the task; he shows no warmth or social engagement.

Agreeableness.behavioral_evidence: He is sarcastic ('delightfully reassuring'), impatient, and distrustful, showing low cooperativeness and antagonism.

Neuroticism.behavioral_evidence: He privately shows discomfort (wincing at the Mark) but publicly maintains a controlled, stoic facade.
